claims.statement: A point emission equals the capability of every realization consistent with the registered inputs.
assumptions: candidacy cuts are exact set restrictions
the external capability functional is total on the universe
falsifiers: a point emitted for a multi-valued image
a resource-inadmissible candidate pruned from the survivor set
UNSATISFIED coerced to 0
claims.strongest_parent: partial identification / identified sets and reject-option decision theory
limits: unconditional only over consistent worlds; the bridge to an actual system is KP-1D

claims.statement: A point is emitted iff the contract functional is constant on the nonempty survivor set; otherwise abstention is forced by an exhibited pair.
falsifiers: a constant image forced to abstain
an abstention whose identified set omits a surviving value
an abstention with no witness pair
limits: query-relative: constancy of a coarser query does not require model identification

claims.statement: The ten frozen failure modes partition the registered input grid.
assumptions: the registered cut ladder and its order
falsifiers: an input in two modes
an input in no mode
an alarm raised on the true taxonomy
claims.strongest_parent: constrained-optimisation active-set reasoning and nested feasible classes
limits: the taxonomy is a partition of the registered grid, not of all possible systems

claims.statement: First-crossing attribution is order-dependent; the boundary is mapped by exhaustive order census plus a sharp counterexample.
falsifiers: order census not run
order-sensitive count not reported
no counterexample shipped
claims.strongest_parent: the non-uniqueness of active constraints in conjunctive systems
counterexample_methods: sharp case: lever {Res}, labels {expressivity, reachability, resource}
limits: EARNED_BY_COUNTEREXAMPLE: proven structural, not an implementation defect; KP-2C survives unconditionally once the order is registered

claims.statement: No code path emits a value without a typed uncertainty object.
assumptions: the reachable call graph of predict()
validation by raise, never by assert
falsifiers: a reachable value-returning statement that is not an emit() call
more than one carrier construction site
any grid exception
counterexample_methods: ast audit flags the planted bare-return hostile while the true module is clean
limits: structural over this module; not a claim about other packages

claims.statement: The emitted object contains the true capability in exactly 100,800/100,800 registered (input, consistent-world) pairs.
falsifiers: a pair whose true value is outside the emitted object
an identified set omitting a surviving value
limits: exact finite coverage, NOT an empirical calibration-error measurement

claims.statement: Exactly three Section K rows are reconciled at the frozen scope.
assumptions: FREEZE_V1.md, TAXONOMY_V1.md and SCOPE_V1.md precede every executable artifact in git order
falsifiers: a second-tranche row reconciled
a parent blob drift
the receipt read as held-out, real-system, calibration-error or OOD evidence
limits: the two routes are same-author and do not constitute independent replication (EV4 not claimed)

open_gaps.premise: F observes only the registered constraints.
open_gaps.inference: A point emission is sound over all consistent worlds.
open_gaps.unresolved_assumption: The actual system satisfies every registered constraint.
open_gaps.possible_counterexample: The exhibited KP-1D case: registered K_M excludes the true realization, whose capability is 1/2 while the sound emitted point is 0.
open_gaps.evidence_needed: A registration-validity check against an external ground truth, i.e. the held-out tranche.
open_gaps.materiality: Bounds the interpretation of a point emission; cannot reverse the scoped theorem.

open_gaps.premise: The registered search cut is a candidacy restriction only.
open_gaps.inference: The search-budget mode attributes shortfall to the cost-feasible search prefix.
open_gaps.unresolved_assumption: No selection or optimality rule is registered, so proxy/contract objective misalignment is out of scope.
open_gaps.possible_counterexample: A registered search objective that is not the contract score would make the selected system's capability differ from the prefix ceiling.
open_gaps.evidence_needed: A registered selection rule plus a misalignment mode.
open_gaps.materiality: Would add a mode; cannot break the present partition.

open_gaps.premise: Internal proofs, two same-author routes, nine hostiles and a null control pass.
open_gaps.unresolved_assumption: No independent hostile reviewer and no disjoint-author replication has signed this tranche.
open_gaps.possible_counterexample: A reviewer identifies an unregistered cut or an uncovered emission path.
open_gaps.evidence_needed: Independent review report and a disjoint implementation.
open_gaps.materiality: Can change closure level; cannot silently promote the local result.
